{{Start date|df=yes|1999|12|20}} (Public) | hq_location_city = [[Mumbai, Maharashtra]] | hq_location_country = [[India]] }} '''Cinevistaas Limited''', formerly known as Cinevista Communications Limited, is an Indian production house founded by [[Prem Krishen]].{{Cite web|url=http://www.afaqs.com/news/company_briefs/index.html?id=44451_Cinevistaas+Limited+forays+into+the+Southern+regional+content+production|title=Cinevistaas Limited|first=Shraddha|last=Shiriskar|work=Afaqs!|date=26 February 2010}} Based in [[Mumbai, Maharashtra]], it is known for producing successful shows like ''[[Crime Patrol (TV series)|Crime Patrol]]'', ''[[Sanjivani (2002 TV series)|Sanjivani]]'', ''[[Dill Mill Gayye]]'', ''[[Dil Dosti Dance]]'', ''[[Ek Hazaaron Mein Meri Behna Hai]]'', ''[[Ek Hasina Thi (TV series)|Ek Hasina Thi]]'', ''[[Beyhadh]]'', and ''[[Bepannah]]''.{{cite news |title=Cinevista explores new vistas |url=http://www.expressindia.com/fe/daily/20000210/ffe08107.html |publisher=[[Indian Express]] |date=10 February 2000 }} ==History== The company was formed on 1 January 1993 by [[Prem Krishen]] and Sunil Mehta as a Partnership firm known as 'Cinevista Communications' but was subsequently incorporated as a Private Limited Company as 'Cinevista Communications Private Limited' under Part IX of the Companies Act, 1956 and became a Public Limited Company on 20 December 1999 as 'Cinevista Communications Limited'.[http://www.outlookmoney.com/dp/dp14551.htm]{{Dead link|date=July 2020|bot=InternetArchiveBot|fix-attempted=yes}} In 2016, one of the key producers, Sidharth Malhotra moved out of Cinevistaas and started his own production company.{{Cite web|url=https://www.tellychakkar.com/tv/tv-news/siddharth-p-malhotra-moves-out-of-cinevistaas-go-solo-producer-160625|title=Siddharth P Malhotra moves out of Cinevistaas; to go 'solo' as Producer|first=Tellychakkar|last=Team|website=Tellychakkar.com}} In 2018, on the sets of [[Bepannaah]], a fire broke out, it has been said that fire safety equipment was not working in the studio, and the studio did not submit a mandatory working check for the fire fighting systems, hence they were disallowed to shoot until proper fire safety is put in place, during the fire a 20 year old assistant also died. {{Cite news|url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/city/mumbai/cinevista-studios-gets-notice-for-fire-safety-violations/articleshow/62422055.cms|title=Cinevista Studios gets notice for fire safety violations | Mumbai News - Times of India|website=The Times of India|date=9 January 2018 }} ==Productions== The company has produced the following television and films: ===Television=== {|class="wikitable" ! extract: Cinevistaas Limited, formerly known as Cinevista Communications Limited, is an Indian production house founded by Prem Krishen. Based in Mumbai, Maharashtra, it is known for producing successful shows like Crime Patrol, Sanjivani, Dill Mill Gayye, Dil Dosti Dance, Ek Hazaaron Mein Meri Behna Hai, Ek Hasina Thi, Beyhadh, and Bepannah.
